newspec-a: failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））
Hospital H1-H3 + an age-72 no-sex patient, NH N1/N3/N4 + a no-unit resident, pairwise-distinct values (final2). Per card: own name, room/unit, badge and Hospital diagnosis present; no neighbour value on any card; no invented sex or room; no undefined/null/NaN. Fails: (1) no card shows a hospital day (Hospital) or visit number (Nursing Home) - 14 card readings; (2) Q1-dependent: every card shows age as '76y', never '76F' - but the app has no way to enter sex (no sex input anywhere in src/; the schema field roundingFields.sex / snfFields.sex was written only by this test's API seed), so these 11 cells wait for Q1 (where sex comes from), as the matrix oracle says; (3) Q4-dependent: every Nursing Home card shows its stored diagnosis - 10 cells, judged per TC-03 while Q4 is open.
产品问题: On the home list no card shows the hospital day (Hospital) or visit number (Nursing Home), so a patient on hospital day 6 or a resident on a 5th visit looks the same as one added today. Breaks UAT TC-01 Expected Result ('the hospital day or visit number') and TFA-92579 AC 3. Q1-dependent, not a rendering-only bug: the card shows 'Room 412 · 76y', not '76F', and there is no way to enter sex in the app. Q4-dependent: Nursing Home cards show the stored diagnosis, which TC-03 says the NH card must not show.
Also: [dev datasets] 失败; [本地 datasets] 失败

testCase.name: [本地] S26 Every card on a multi-patient list shows its own values, not a neighbour's (card-scoped)

descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B23 · P1 · 已知

病人卡片缺字段：年龄是「76y」不是「76F」，医院卡片没有住院天数，养老院卡片没有访视次数

票：TFA-92579 AC3–4 ready for qa · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：dev + 本地

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-01/S03, TC-01/S05, TC-01/S06

思路 / Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S26 「多病人列表上的每张卡片显示自己的值，不是旁边卡片的（按卡片范围）」 Every card on a multi-patient list shows its own values, not a neighbour's (card-scoped)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Each patient renders as a card on the home screen showing the patient's first and last name and room (Nursing Home: unit/room).（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 3）
  • U2 The card shows the chief diagnosis on Hospital cards only; a Nursing Home card shows no diagnosis.（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 3；UAT TC-03）
  • U3 The card shows age/sex in the "76F" format.（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 3）
  • U4 The card shows the New Admission / Follow-up / Consult badge.（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 3）
  • U5 The card shows the hospital day (Hospital) or the visit number (Nursing Home).（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 3）
  • U8 With multiple patients loaded, everything above holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home.（UAT TC-01；UAT 3.3）

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given seededCensus H1–H3 and N1, N3, N4 with pairwise-distinct values, plus a make-session-shaped Hospital patient (age 72, no sex) and resident (no unit); lists unfiltered

When On the unfiltered Hospital list and on both Nursing Home lists, scope to each card with page.getByRole('button', { name: `Open chart for ${name}` })

Then Each card contains its own room/unit, age/sex, badge, day/visit number (and diagnosis on Hospital only) and none of its neighbours' values; no invented sex or room

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Per card: toContainText(own values) and not.toContainText(each neighbour's values); NH cards not.toContainText(their stored diagnosis) (U2 / Q4). 3.4 identity line: the age-72 no-sex Hospital card not.toMatch(/\b72\s*y?\s*[FM]\b|\b(fe)?male\b/i); the unit-less resident card not.toMatch(/Room|Unit/i); no 'undefined' / 'null' / 'NaNy'. Day/visit format per Q2/Q3; …

在哪跑：本地 newspec-a（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S26 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92579 ready for qa；TFA-92581 ready for qa

混合列表里每张卡片都显示自己的姓名、房号和徽章，没有串到别的病人；但所有卡片都没有住院天数或访视次数，年龄是「76y」不带性别，养老院卡片还显示了诊断。

On a mixed list each card shows its own name, room and badge with nothing borrowed from a neighbour, but no card shows a hospital day or visit number, age reads '76y' without sex, and Nursing Home cards show the stored diagnosis.

依据：newspec-a, card-scoped. Missing day/visit = dev report §2 #5 (14 readings). Sex is Q1-dependent: there is no sex input anywhere in src/ (11 cells). The NH diagnosis = §2 #4 / Q4 (10 cells). Nothing leaks between cards, and no undefined/null/NaN appears.

并进来的：本地 datasets TC-01/S26 (same failure, folded into this result)

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-a。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：newspec-a。

本地新 lane newspec-a：newspec-a/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（newspec-a/plan.json，automatable: yes）：Seed H1-H3 and N1/N3/N4 with pairwise-distinct values (sex stored through the schema's sex field) plus an age-72 no-sex Hospital patient and a no-unit resident; on the unfiltered Hospital list and both NH lists scope to each card (getByRole button 'Open chart for <name>') and assert own values present, neighbours' absent, NH diagnosis absent, no invented sex/room, no undefined/null/NaN. — Card-scoped Playwright locators on a seeded fresh account.

Detail:

Hospital H1-H3 + an age-72 no-sex patient, NH N1/N3/N4 + a no-unit resident, pairwise-distinct values (final2). Per card: own name, room/unit, badge and Hospital diagnosis present; no neighbour value on any card; no invented sex or room; no undefined/null/NaN. Fails: (1) no card shows a hospital day (Hospital) or visit number (Nursing Home) - 14 card readings; (2) Q1-dependent: every card shows age as '76y', never '76F' - but the app has no way to enter sex (no sex input anywhere in src/; the schema field roundingFields.sex / snfFields.sex was written only by this test's API seed), so these 11 cells wait for Q1 (where sex comes from), as the matrix oracle says; (3) Q4-dependent: every Nursing Home card shows its stored diagnosis - 10 cells, judged per TC-03 while Q4 is open.

产品问题：On the home list no card shows the hospital day (Hospital) or visit number (Nursing Home), so a patient on hospital day 6 or a resident on a 5th visit looks the same as one added today. Breaks UAT TC-01 Expected Result ('the hospital day or visit number') and TFA-92579 AC 3. Q1-dependent, not a rendering-only bug: the card shows 'Room 412 · 76y', not '76F', and there is no way to enter sex in the app. Q4-dependent: Nursing Home cards show the stored diagnosis, which TC-03 says the NH card must not show.

证据：附了 5 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (our scripted spec, not written yet): it would run on a seededCensus fresh account made through the local admin helpers; dev has no admin key and one shared account, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
